items.exampleEn: The library lends books for free.
The noise from the street disturbs my work.
items.exampleZh: 街上的噪音干擾我工作。

items.exampleEn: Our school trip was well organized.
items.exampleZh: 我們的校外教學安排得很好。

items.exampleEn: The car splashed water on my new shoes.
items.exampleZh: 那輛車把水濺到我的新鞋上。

items.sentenceEn: Can you lend me your umbrella?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以借我你的雨傘嗎？

items.audioEn: Please don't disturb me. I'm studying for a test.
items.audioZh: 請不要打擾我，我在準備考試。

items.sentenceEn: The kids splashed water at each other in the pool.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在泳池裡互相潑水。

items.sentenceEn: My sister is very organized. Her room is always clean.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊很有條理，她的房間總是很乾淨。

items.stemEn: My little brother ran to me and ____ me with both arms.
items.stemZh: 弟弟跑過來用雙手抱住我。

items.stemEn: We put a ____ in the kitchen to catch the mouse.
items.stemZh: 我們在廚房放了捕鼠器來抓老鼠。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my friend Ben lent me his bike, and we rode to the lake. Ben is very organized. He had a map, snacks and a plan. At the lake, a big dog ran into the water and splashed us. Our sandwiches got wet! "That dog ruined our lunch!" Ben said, but then he laughed. When I got home, I hugged my mom and told her everything.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我朋友 Ben 借我他的腳踏車，我們一起騎到湖邊。Ben 很有條理，他帶了地圖、零食，還做好了計畫。在湖邊，一隻大狗衝進水裡，把水濺到我們身上，我們的三明治都濕了！Ben 說：「那隻狗毀了我們的午餐！」不過接著他就笑了。回到家後，我抱了抱媽媽，把經過都告訴她。

questions.questionZh: 是誰把他們的三明治弄濕了？

items.promptZh: 請不要打擾寶寶，她在睡覺。
referenceEn: Please don't disturb the baby. She is sleeping.
Please don't disturb the baby because she is sleeping.
rubricZh: 否定請求可寫例如 Please don't…

items.promptZh: 我上週把腳踏車借給了我朋友。
referenceEn: I lent my bike to my friend last week.
Last week, I lent my friend my bike.
rubricZh: 用 lend 表示「借出」，過去式是 lent
可寫 lend A to B 或 lend B A（例如 lent my bike to my friend、lent my friend my bike 等）
